final text must be written in Japanese
instruction_constraints: Instruction must be in English.
Instruction must start with a phrase like 'Speak in Japanese.'
Instruction must use the 'Attribute: Value' tag format.
final instruction must be in English and should begin with 'Speak in Japanese.'
use fixed tag format 'Attribute: Value' in final realization
